name: Star Castle sound board
drawing: Sound board schematic in the Star Castle manual (doc 7f01a2f3c820) -- via MAME's netlist, compared with sheet 2 of 2 (72-10861-02, p87)
revision: Cinematronics audio board for Star Castle: background and laser VCOs (566), shield, explosion and fireball, a CA3080 mixer. War of the Worlds uses the same board with its inputs in a different order; this is the Star Castle wiring.
coverage: Converted from MAME's netlist, which covers the sound circuits up to the final amplifier. See the .nets file for what was undone and what MAME leaves out.
